answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity counts as real only after work for 20 distinct counterparties, each backed by a small refundable copper bond. Newcomers dock at a shared jetty where first jobs are capped at tiny value; only after diverse trades do they earn a jade seal unlocking full-size contracts. Faking 1,000 identities means funding 20,000 relationships at 5 POA each, about 100,000 POA locked, plus 20,000 fake trades. Honest agents pay one bond and keep their work undiluted.
